notes: 双击6 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ ，HQQ，1 农@building_economy/mill.webp@ & @building_economy/house.webp@ 返回吃羊.
二本地标 @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.webp@ 提前 编号4 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@，385以上手动提交

持续金马和小弓，保护金区和背鹿，尽量不要断，持续生产@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@@unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@

开始8农吃猪肉，立塔，尽早开二金
兵回来，TC十几个吃肉农民去建造@landmark_french/guild-hall.webp@，TC补吃肉
